```yaml
name: i18n-check

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - 'src/main/resources/i18n/**'
      - 'src/test/resources/i18n/**'

jobs:
  i18n-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Validate i18n properties files
        run: |
          echo "Checking for syntax errors in i18n properties files..."
          # Check for unescaped special characters or malformed keys
          find src/main/resources/i18n -name "*.properties" -exec sh -c '
            for file do
              if ! grep -P "^[^=]+=.*$" "$file" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "Warning: Potential syntax issue in $file"
              fi
            done
          ' sh {} +
          
          echo "Checking for duplicate keys..."
          for file in src/main/resources/i18n/*.properties; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              keys=$(grep -oP '^[^=]+' "$file" | sort)
              duplicates=$(echo "$keys" | uniq -d)
              if [ -n "$duplicates" ]; then
                echo "Error: Duplicate keys found in $file:"
                echo "$duplicates"
                exit 1
              fi
            fi
          done

      - name: Check for missing translations
        run: |
          echo "Comparing base language file with translations..."
          BASE_FILE="src/main/resources/i18n/messages.properties"
          
          if [ ! -f "$BASE_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Base i18n file not found, skipping translation check."
            exit 0
          fi

          BASE_KEYS=$(grep -oP '^[^=]+' "$BASE_FILE" | sort)
          
          for file in src/main/resources/i18n/messages_*.properties; do
            if [ "$file" != "$BASE_FILE" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then
              FILE_KEYS=$(grep -oP '^[^=]+' "$file" | sort)
              MISSING=$(comm -23 <(echo "$BASE_KEYS") <(echo "$FILE_KEYS"))
              
              if [ -n "$MISSING" ]; then
                echo "Warning: Missing keys in $file:"
                echo "$MISSING"
              fi
            fi
          done

      - name: Run Maven compile to ensure i18n resources are valid
        run: mvn compile -DskipTests -q
```
